from sympy import symbols, solve, Rational
S,T=symbols('S T')
s=solve([S-10-3*(T-10), S+10-2*(T+10)],[S,T])
r=Rational(s[S],s[T])
opts={'A':Rational(2,7),'B':Rational(7,2),'C':Rational(7,3),'D':Rational(3,7)}
assert r==opts['C']
for k in 'ABD': assert r!=opts[k]

t=F(92)/rel
opts={'A':21,'B':26,'C':22,'D':23}

for k in 'ABC': assert t!=opts[k]
